name: gamez_open_and_read_zbd_header
description: GameZ::OpenAndReadZBDHeader opens a ZBD file, reads and validates the 36-byte header, and returns the positioned stream only for supported magic/version pairs.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent GameZ ZBD/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4556a0 validates fopen with "rb", fread of one 0x24-byte zClass_ZbdHeader, magic 0x02971222, version 0x0f, zError::ReportOldNoOp failures at lines 0x515/0x51e/0x527, fclose on failures, and returning the open stream on success.

The native fixture smoke verifies successful header copy, stream position after the header, next-byte preservation, and failure returns for truncated, wrong-magic, and wrong-version files. The retail m1 smoke opens support/zbd/m1/gamez.zbd and validates the exact shipped header fields.
